selected_evidence.requirement: Groups and persistent directory ACL configuration
selected_evidence.summary: Shows both groups and the directory's ownership, setgid mode, access ACL, and default inherited ACL.

selected_evidence.requirement: Writers can modify contents and readers have read-only access
selected_evidence.summary: Direct tests show writer create/modify/delete succeeds while reader list/read succeeds and reader append/create/delete is denied. Final proof shows the directory clean after test-artifact removal.

Shows the healthy pre-restart filesystem, ACL, data and access baseline; safe reboot acknowledgement; boot ID changing from 5fb1b173-c1c8-4647-b118-0145511f0fcc to 406892c0-b13e-4fa4-8d08-41df3bf162fc; and recovered ACLs, matching checksums, groups, filesystem, and effective permissions.
